The remaining roll is about 100 g and roughly 150 kcal. The dark sauce is about 15 g and roughly 15 kcal. The yellow sauce is about 20 g and roughly 30 kcal. The scraps in the bowl and plate add about 10 g and roughly 10 kcal.

That comes to about 145 g and 205 kcal.
